turns.text: Ambition is a double-edged sword, I think; it can propel people to remarkable achievements, but it can also become all-consuming.
Growing up, I was encouraged to pursue medicine, largely because it's seen as a prestigious and secure career in our community.
It took me a while to admit that my real passion lay in architecture, and switching fields was, frankly, quite a daunting decision.
In hindsight, though, I'm glad I followed my instincts, since I find the work genuinely fulfilling rather than merely respectable.
So if a younger person asked my advice, I'd tell them to weigh other people's expectations carefully, but ultimately to trust their own judgement.
